title: Just Closed | 557 Cactus Spur, Killeen, TX 76542
description:
Dear Mrs. Beulah, Mrs. Latrice, & Don,

I want to express my deepest gratitude for once again trusting me with such a significant chapter in your family’s journey. I am truly blessed to have had the opportunity to serve you all. Today’s decision will leave a lasting impact on your family for generations, and I am honored to be a part of it. I pray for endless blessings and happiness to come your way, knowing that Nicole and I have nothing but the best wishes for you.

Nicole Pias-James, thank you for being a part of this journey and for making these precious moments possible. I am beyond grateful for your partnership.

Sending love and best wishes to you all! 🤗💖

With much love,
Gloria Miller
